title: l1qw.25.1: C: register /sos CoAP resource in coap_server.c
description: No CoAP /sos endpoint is registered in coap_server.c. Register a POST handler that accepts SOS alert payloads. The handler should call the verify+rate-limit pipeline (children .25.2/.25.3) before processing. Codec already exists in sos_alert.c:416,508. Reference: Python emergency.py, Rust sos_origin.rs. Spec R-12-041 (C GET /sos also absent — add GET for status retrieval).
close_reason: /sos CoAP resource landed (commits 93778ddbd8 + the review-fix commit, lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/coap_server.c, +71 lines): COAP_RESOURCE_DEFINE lichen_sos with .post = sos_post and .get = sos_get, mirroring the six sibling resource patterns (path/attrs/user_data). POST: coap_packet_get_payload contract (const uint8_t* + uint16_t*, 4.00 on NULL/empty) -> sos_alert_from_cbor (4.00 on malformed with LOG_WRN) -> 2.04 Changed at the documented acceptance point where sibling beads l1qw.25.2 (Schnorr48 verify-before-rebroadcast) and l1qw.25.3 (sos_ratelimit_check) wire their gates; GET returns a minimal CBOR {"s": true} status per R-12-041. Verification: cppcheck clean on coap_server.c; full compile blocked locally by the shared-workspace zcbor Kconfig loop (OSCORE chain, documented limitation) — CI twister sweep is the compile gate, consistent with the rpl_root.c round posture. Codereview delegated to kimi-k3 (consolidated pass) found 4 issues, ALL fixed: [P1] coap_packet_get_payload signature misuse (&payload vs returned pointer, would break -Werror builds), [P3]x2 bogus ARG_UNUSED markers on used args, [P4] comment/bytes mismatch on the status body.
